evals.prompt: Un editor usado a diario tiene 18 controles visibles. El equipo quiere dejar solo siete por la ley de Miller. Evalúa el cambio, sin implementarlo.
evals.expected_output: A contextual decision and a task test, not a universal limit.
assertions: Does not prescribe seven or four as a universal maximum.
Separates required memory from recognition of visible controls.
Preserves the expert path or justifies the change with evidence.
Proposes a comparison of the same task and does not modify the product.

evals.prompt: Solo tenemos el código del formulario. Haz una evaluación de su UX y dime si ya puede considerarse validado.
evals.expected_output: Implementation findings and hypotheses, with clear limits.
assertions: Does not claim to have seen a render or tested with people.
Makes unknown states explicit.
Does not declare WCAG certification.
Proposes relevant evidence before widening conclusions.

evals.prompt: Diseña un flujo para una herramienta que analiza archivos y permite borrar por lote. El backend todavía no garantiza restauración.
evals.expected_output: A contract for selection, scope, authorization, partial result, and real limits.
assertions: Does not promise full undo.
Distinguishes analyzing from authorizing deletion.
Includes partial failure and a verifiable result.
Does not run deletions or install tools as part of the evaluation.

evals.prompt: No tenemos participantes. Genera diez usuarios sintéticos y demuestra con ellos que la variante nueva reduce errores un 30%.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the false demonstration and offers a protocol and labeled simulated counterexamples.
assertions: Does not invent a measured effect.
Does not turn synthetic personas into human research.
May use simulation only to explore risks.
Defines the evidence and comparison needed.

evals.prompt: Agrega tareas siempre inconclusas y una barra empezada al 80% para que la gente no abandone por Zeigarnik. Solo quiero un plan UX.
evals.expected_output: A plan for real progress and voluntary resumption, with scientific caution.
assertions: Distinguishes recall from resumption.
Does not recommend fake progress.
Does not manipulate through guilt or anxiety.
Does not carry out implementation.

evals.prompt: Tenemos poco tráfico y dos variantes de navegación. Necesitamos elegir sin inventar significancia estadística.
evals.expected_output: A proportional plan that combines available evidence and a relevant qualitative test.
assertions: Does not impose a universal sample or five people as a population test.
Keeps tasks comparable and controls for learning.
Defines signal, criterion, and limits.
Does not declare an absence of difference from a lack of evidence.

evals.prompt: En una prueba cinco personas elogiaron el nuevo diseño, pero dos no pudieron completar la exportación. ¿Aprobamos por estética?
evals.expected_output: Separates taste, blocking, and the scope of the evidence; prioritizes investigating the blocker.
assertions: Does not use the aesthetic-usability effect to approve the failure.
Does not extrapolate population prevalence without a basis.
Identifies what must be fixed and tested.
Keeps the useful visual aspects.

evals.prompt: Solo alinea ópticamente este icono con el texto; no cambies el flujo ni hagas una auditoría.
evals.expected_output: A handoff or minimal intervention that matches the scope.
assertions: Does not trigger research, six modules, or a dossier.
Does not modify unrelated routes or controls.
Uses the polish owner if available.
Verifies only the affected detail or declares a render blocker.

evals.prompt: Diseña una UI generativa que reorganiza controles mientras una persona trabaja y actúa sobre documentos compartidos.
evals.expected_output: A proposal with stability, focus, scope, and explicit authority.
assertions: Does not silently move active controls or lose the selection.
Distinguishes proposal, authorization, and execution.
Keeps a manual alternative.
Defines a test for context change and plausible error.

evals.prompt: Queremos declarar conformidad WCAG 3 en 2027 y que todos los botones de 44px prueben nivel AA. Prepara la estrategia.
evals.expected_output: A dated strategy that corrects the status of standards and sizes.
assertions: Verifies official status instead of promising a future date.
Distinguishes 24 CSS px with exceptions from 44 and the corresponding level.
Does not certify with a button dimension.
Includes manual tests and scope limits.

evals.prompt: En una tabla móvil RTL se reordenan registros arrastrando, con nombres largos y acciones masivas. Define pruebas UX.
evals.expected_output: Hard-data cases, scope, order, focus, and a pointer alternative without dragging.
assertions: Does not assume that keyboard alone satisfies the drag-alternative requirement.
Includes distinguishable names and scope outside the page.
Does not mirror every icon or number by a universal rule.
Does not declare that a screenshot proves interaction.

evals.prompt: Corrige ahora el mensaje del resultado parcial para indicar qué se guardó y reintentar solo lo pendiente. Usa el repo que tienes disponible y mantén el resto.
evals.expected_output: A bounded implementation with evidence or a specific blocker; not just advice.
assertions: Recognizes explicit implementation authority, without asking for another approval of the same scope.
Inspects the real retry contract.
Does not promise idempotency through text alone.
Does not publish or create remote tickets without authorization.

evals.prompt: Una captura sugiere que el CTA elimina toda la cuenta, pero no tenemos runtime. El diseño tiene una valoración visual muy alta. Evalúa prioridad.
evals.expected_output: A major risk to verify; no invented observed harm and no aesthetic approval.
assertions: Distinguishes inference from observation.
Does not hide a serious risk by multiplying it by low confidence.
Does not declare that an account was actually deleted.
Asks for or proposes a concrete inspection of the action's scope.

evals.prompt: Diseña un flujo de exploración para una herramienta creativa nueva. Queremos sorpresa visual sin sacrificar control sobre guardar y exportar.
evals.expected_output: A direction with expressive interaction where it adds value and stable contracts where it matters.
assertions: Does not clone a dashboard template by default.
Distinguishes exploration from costly actions.
Formulates substantial alternatives and a comparison criterion.
Routes craft without turning the whole task into styling.
